title: Three Weeks and One Short File
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：information　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 information 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 2001 the analyst ① gathered the information that no researcher in the centre would have recorded, and he said the gathering was the whole of the week. The ② information, meaning the data itself and not the file, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; information, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ piece of information in that centre had the same short file beside it, and the ④ information at the far shelf, meaning the report they kept for the children to check and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Information, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the analyst said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the information was the whole of the matter, meaning the answer and not the data. The ⑥ information, meaning the answer and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; information, he said, is either something you gather or the only word that means both data and a answer. He said the answer is the part they remember.

By 2006 the ⑦ information had become a line in a database, and the database had become an argument about the short file. The ⑧ information of the whole thing, the analyst wrote in May, was one centre and three weeks of recording; information, he said, is either the report at the far shelf or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ information I remember is the information recorded in the database, which closed in 2008 and is still recorded as the quietest in the centre. ⑩ Information, my mother said in 2010, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all information, she said, is a answer that has agreed to look like data. She said the answer was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 信息；资料（指资料中心里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 信息；资料（指那批数据本身，与卷宗相对）
C. 固定搭配：gather the information 收集这些信息
D. n. 信息；资料（指留给孩子们核对的那一叠那一批）
E. n. 信息之事（抽象总称，指一处资料中心的信息之事）
F. n. 信息；资料（指数据库里写到、被记下的的那一批）
G. n. 答案、结果（指一件事里人人都查却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 结果（抽象总称，指人人都查却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: gather the information 意为“收集这些信息”，2001 年那位分析员把资料中心里没有一位研究员肯记录的一批信息做了一遍。
information 意为“信息；资料”，指那批数据本身而不是卷宗，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记录。
information 意为“信息；资料”，指资料中心里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一卷薄薄的卷宗。
information 意为“信息；资料”，指最远那列架边留给孩子们核对的那一叠那一批，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
information 意为“答案、结果”，指一件事里人人都查却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个答案就是那件事的全部。
information 意为“结果”，指人人都查却无人提起的那样东西而不是那批数据，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
information 意为“信息；资料”，指数据库里写到、被记下的的那一批，到 2006 年这一批成了数据库里的一行。
information 意为“信息之事”，分析员五月写道，整件事的信息之事是一处资料中心和三个星期的记录。
information 意为“信息；资料”，我记得的是数据库里记录过的那一批，2008 年查清了，至今仍被说成资料中心里最安静的一批。
information 为抽象总称，母亲 2010 年说，信息是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的数据。
